The 50-Class Matrix

Every calling, lane, requirement, signature skill, and exact build count for Echoes of the 100th Floor.

On this page

  1. Pure (10)
  2. Hybrid (20)

Generated from design/classes.json by tools/validate-classes.mjs --matrix. Do not edit by hand. Edit the JSON, then regenerate.

Every legal distribution of 10 points across the six stats (3003 builds) maps to exactly one class. Secret callings are checked globally first. Otherwise the two highest stats select a lane (PURE_<STAT> when the top stat is 6+ and the second is 2 or less, else the canonical pair). Within a lane, classes are checked by descending priority; the last class in each lane is the lane default.
